steps.body: A number line shows addition as a hop forward: start at the first number and hop the size of the second.
steps.narration: A number line shows addition as a hop forward: start at the first number and hop the size of the second.

widget.prompt: Start at 45. Hop forward 3. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 45 and count on 3: you land on 48.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 48 — hopping forward 3 from 45 gives 48.

predict.prompt: You hop forward from 45. Does the landing number get bigger or smaller?
predict.reveal: Hopping FORWARD always lands on a bigger number — that is what addition does on a number line.
